### If You Want to Love, You Must Die to the Law
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/if-you-want-to-love-you-must-die-to-the-law
Passage: Romans 7:4
Points:
- True love is produced not through rule-keeping under the Law, but through living union with the risen Christ.
- Dying to the Law means abandoning external checklists as the primary source of moral transformation.
- Genuine love flows from internal heart renewal, a good conscience, and sincere faith.
- The Law functions lawfully when it convicts sinners and drives them to the grace found in the gospel.

### Free from the Law
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/free-law
Passage: Romans 7:1-3
Points:
- Sanctification does not merit eternal life, which is granted solely by grace through Christ's righteousness.
- Growth in holiness can happen only when a believer is delivered from sin's rule and placed under grace.
- Apart from Christ, the Law merely serves as an instrument that sin exploits to increase disobedience.
- Just as physical death terminates marital obligation under civil law, dying with Christ frees believers from the Law's condemnation.
